recoveryTargets.blobs: Fresh restore-<random>/ object prefixes in the scratch private Blob store

nativeIdentity: Isolated FINITE_HOME keys under ignored .local-state/native; no production identity copied

wildcard.dns: Existing Vercel nameservers and wildcard DNS; no manual record or nameserver changes
wildcard.probeSites: wild-probe-<random>; disabled after validation, named in evidence/wildcard-live.json
wildcard.teardown: Remove only the *.sites-poc.lwn.lol project domain/alias when retiring this experiment; do not delete the lwn.lol zone, existing records, or unrelated domains.

platformGit.config: app/vercel.json also disables all Git branch patterns except the exact experiment branch
